caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.description: See DeerFlow in action through replays.

cases.title: Optimize a national logistics network
cases.description: Use mixed-integer operations research models to rebalance warehouses, fleet assignments, and service levels under cost constraints.

cases.title: Simulate epidemic spread with the SIR model
cases.description: Calibrate infection parameters, visualize the susceptible-infected-recovered curves, and quantify intervention impact.

cases.title: Design a resilient investment portfolio
cases.description: Blend modern portfolio theory with stress testing to allocate capital while satisfying risk tolerance and liquidity rules.

cases.title: Set prices with game-theory reasoning
cases.description: Model competitor reactions, compute Nash equilibria, and translate the insights into actionable pricing playbooks.

cases.title: Plan trajectory for an aerospace mission
cases.description: Solve multi-phase optimal control problems that respect thrust, thermal, and communication constraints.

cases.title: Select the best learning algorithm
cases.description: Compare statistical models with automated cross-validation, error attribution, and prompt-grounded explanations.

cases.title: Forecast predator-prey dynamics
cases.description: Fit differential equations to ecological data to understand oscillations and sensitivity to environmental shocks.
